sections.title: Moving In or Out of Mid-Wilshire and 90036
sections.content: Mid-Wilshire takes in the Miracle Mile, the stretch of Wilshire Boulevard between Fairfax and La Brea where LACMA's David Geffen Galleries now cross over the street and the Academy Museum fills the old May Company Building. Around it, in and near ZIP 90036, you'll find Wilshire office towers, Park La Brea (the area's largest residential complex) and pre-war apartment buildings on the side streets south of the boulevard. We plan each move around the building you're leaving and the one you're moving into. Credentials, ratings and rates up front Licensed and insured: CPUC licensed, with USDOT 3398018, MC 1153871 and CAL-T0192140, plus full liability coverage and workers' compensation. Reviewed in public: 4.9 on Google from 1,007 reviews, with the full rating block further down this page. Hourly pricing, extras listed: $119/hr for 2 movers + truck Monday–Thursday at the cash rate and $135/hr Friday–Sunday, plus a $30 gas fee. Your $50 deposit goes toward the total. Stairs, long carries and multiple stops stay inside the hourly rate, whether you're in a walk-up or a building with an elevator.

sections.title: Packing Help for Miracle Mile Apartments
sections.content: Our packing services cover a whole apartment or just the rooms you'd rather not tackle, like the kitchen, the bookshelves and the framed art. Blankets, shrink wrap, tape and wardrobe boxes come with every local move, and we pack for long-distance moves as well. What the packing crew handles Closets: Wardrobe boxes keep hanging clothes on the bar, so shirts and coats arrive without being folded into cartons. Breakables: Glassware, lamps, mirrors and framed prints are wrapped, boxed and labeled by room. Furniture: Beds, tables and shelving are taken apart, padded with blankets and shrink wrap, and put back together at the new address. Moving art, antiques or pieces that need more than a box? Ask about our white glove movers.

sections.title: Moves Around Mid-Wilshire and Across LA
sections.content: Going from a Miracle Mile apartment to a place near the Original Farmers Market, or from Wilshire to another part of Los Angeles, is a local move billed by the hour; longer hauls go to our long-distance movers. On Wilshire and La Brea, curb lanes marked for buses turn bus-only during Monday–Thursday rush hours and buses on those routes carry enforcement cameras, so we plan loading and truck parking around those windows. Included in the hourly rate Stairs and long carries: Buildings without elevators, long walks from the curb and extra stops add no fees. Furniture and TVs: Disassembly, reassembly and TV unmounting are part of the job, not add-ons. Placement and unpacking: The crew sets each piece where you want it and helps you unpack at the new place. Building management asking for a reserved elevator or a set move window? Tell us when you book and our apartment movers will plan around it; same-day moves are possible when a crew is free.

sections.title: Long-Distance Moves from Mid-Wilshire
sections.content: Moving from 90036 to another state or the other end of California takes more planning than a crosstown job, from packing that holds up on the highway to a delivery date that fits your new lease. For trips east, La Brea Avenue runs straight down to the I-10. If the new address turns out to be closer, our local moving service is a better fit than a long-distance plan. How we prepare a long haul Road-ready packing: Furniture gets blanket wrap and shrink wrap, and boxes are packed tight enough to ride out a long drive. Storage in between: If your lease ends before the new place is ready, we can keep your things in storage until delivery. Interstate authority: USDOT 3398018 and MC 1153871 cover moves across state lines. Call 909-443-0004, Monday through Sunday from 8AM to 6PM, to go over dates and get a quote.

sections.title: Miracle Mile Office Movers
sections.content: With office buildings like Museum Square, the former Prudential Building, and the Wilshire Courtyard campus, the Miracle Mile is as much a place to work as a museum strip. Our commercial movers pack and relocate desks, files and equipment and schedule the job around your building's elevator and loading rules.

faq.question: What does a move inside 90036 run per hour?
faq.answer: Two movers with a truck cost $119/hr Monday–Thursday at the cash rate and $135/hr Friday–Sunday. Each move adds a $30 gas fee, and the $50 deposit is applied toward your total. A piano adds $200 and any item heavier than 300 lbs adds $150; stairs, long carries and multiple stops are already covered by the hourly rate.

faq.question: Where does the moving truck park on Wilshire Boulevard?
faq.answer: On Wilshire and on La Brea Avenue, curb lanes marked for buses turn bus-only during Monday–Thursday rush hours, and buses on those lines carry cameras that record vehicles blocking the lane. We schedule loading outside those periods or use a side street, garage entrance or loading area your building allows. Share your cross streets when you book so we can plan where the truck goes.

faq.question: My building has its own move-in rules. Can you work with them?
faq.answer: Yes. High-rises and managed buildings often set move hours, require an elevator reservation or ask for proof of the mover's insurance ahead of time. Send us your building's requirements when you book; we're CPUC licensed with full liability coverage and workers' compensation, and we time the crew's arrival to the window you're given.

faq.question: Can you move a piano out of an older Miracle Mile building with no elevator?
faq.answer: Yes. Piano moves carry a $200 fee on top of the hourly rate, and the stairs themselves are included. Tell us the piano type and describe the stairs when you book so the crew arrives with the right equipment.

faq.question: Do you offer same-day moves in Mid-Wilshire?
faq.answer: Yes, when a crew is free. Call 909-443-0004 any day between 8AM and 6PM to check what's open. Longer moves within the LA area can fall under the CPUC's Double Drive Time rule, and we'll tell you before booking whether it applies.
